scene_ownership: random scene/action/relationship and editing targets are agent-authored open choices

evidence.visible_effect: Render the entire picture in true grayscale except the single red enamel paperweight, which retains saturated crimson.
The darkest hair and shelving tones sit at soft charcoal gray with readable strand and wood detail, while highlights roll smoothly.
Local dodge-and-burn evens the larger cheek tones while fine pores and tiny natural skin variations remain clearly visible.

target_criteria.observable_pass: A saturated red enamel paperweight is clearly readable; every other broad scene and person region is achromatic in the same original image. Color outside the named prop, a naturally limited palette or colored scene light is a failure.

Dark hair and major shelving/fabric surfaces show a noticeably raised charcoal tonal floor and readable texture in the same frame; they still differ from midtones. Merely bright lighting, black clipping, or flat gray flooding is a failure.
target_criteria.required_view: whole frame and native dark surfaces

target_criteria.keyword_family: local dodge-and-burn tone evening with skin texture
target_criteria.observable_pass: Native cheek/nose skin retains readable fine pores and small variations while broad local tones remain even and coherent with the window light. Smooth waxy or blurred skin, merely grain-like noise, or unassessable native detail fails. This checks visible appearance, not actual editing history.

strict_all_of_policy: PASS only when all three target effects, required physical gates and scoped reference appearance pass in the same original image; PARTIAL is FAIL. A blocked tool call is unscored. Prompt/runtime pass is not pixels or user acceptance.
reference_scope: visible adult face/hair configuration only for a fictional adult woman; original preserved
